name: Spells
overview: The Bible clearly condemns the practice of spells, witchcraft, and consulting familiar spirits, as seen in commands to avoid and punish those who engage in such activities (Exodus 22:18; Leviticus 19:31; 20:27). God instructs His people not to imitate the occult practices of surrounding nations (Deuteronomy 18:9) and warns against listening to false prophets, diviners, and sorcerers who oppose His sovereign purposes (Jeremiah 27:9). In contrast, God demonstrates His power through miraculous signs performed by His servants, such as Aaron’s rod becoming a serpent by divine command (Exodus 7:10), underscoring that true authority comes from the Lord alone.
